Independent viability review of Hypothesis 1 (`h1_v3`) is complete. Both review outputs have been written to:

- [review.txt](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/h1_review2/review.txt) (`1,192` words)
- [verdicts.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/h1_review2/verdicts.json)

### Summary of Findings (`H1`: `VIABLE`)
- **Bounded Hypothesis:** Two-sided, finite-cohort Phylogenetic Generalized Least Squares (PGLS) association of per-genome catalogue dark proteome fraction ($N_{\mathrm{dark}} / N_{\mathrm{proteins,cat}}$) with nearest external GTDB r232 / MGnify amino acid identity (`aai`, spanning $48.678\%\text{–}80.041\%$ across all $n = 237$ desert *Thermoplasmatota* species representatives; $50.389\%\text{–}80.041\%$ across the $236$ `c__SW-10-69-26` and `c__E2` representatives) and desert-normalized shared reciprocal-best-hit gene coverage (`frac_rbh_desert` $= N_{\mathrm{RBH}} / N_{\mathrm{prot,aai}}$), conditioned on CheckM2 completeness, contamination, $\log_{10}(\text{length})$, $\log_{10}(\text{N50})$, and continuous branch-length covariance scaled by Pagel's $\lambda$ on the $1,914$-taxon `ar53` phylogeny (`thermo_tree.nwk`), supplemented by matched-denominator ratio/count-scaling audits and descriptive occupancy of $14,645$ admitted dark families without causal expansion, isolate-cultivation, or disjoint proteome-partition claims.
- **Disposition of Prior Critical Issues (`C1–C5`):**
  - **C1 (Resolved):** 1D-to-2D NumPy broadcasting in whitened GLS $R^2$ is repaired in [`fit_pgls`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v3/scripts/02_v3_pgls_ancestry_models.py#L30-L128) and verified against `statsmodels.GLS` in [v3_pgls_statsmodels_verification.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v3/results/v3_pgls_statsmodels_verification.tsv) ($\max|\Delta R^2_{\mathrm{GLS}}| = 4.44 \times 10^{-15}$; primary PGLS $R^2_{\mathrm{GLS}} = 0.469051$ at $\hat{\lambda}_{\mathrm{ML}} = 0.915784$; OLS $R^2 = 0.495786$).
  - **C2 (Resolved):** Concentrated ML variance ($\mathrm{RSS}/n$) is separated from unbiased residual variance $\mathrm{RSS}/(n-p)$ ($df = 230$) for Student-$t$ standard errors, scientific-notation $p$-values, and conditional $95\%$ Student-$t$ CIs in [v3_pgls_model_summary.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v3/results/v3_pgls_model_summary.tsv), alongside the $95\%$ profile-likelihood CI for $\lambda$ ($[0.846303, 0.957823]$) and full grid sensitivity in [v3_pgls_lambda_profile.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v3/results/v3_pgls_lambda_profile.tsv).
  - **C3 (Resolved):** Pre-specified two-sided exploratory hypothesis tests ($H_0: \beta_j = 0$ vs $H_1: \beta_j \ne 0$) replace the prior post-hoc one-sided framing in [DESIGN.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v3/DESIGN.md#L23-L50) and [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v3/DOSSIER.md#L8-L26).
  - **C4 (Resolved):** Disjoint proteome-partition claims are removed, caller provenance is documented, and [`run_matched_denom_perm`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v3/scripts/03_v3_coupling_and_comparator_audit.py#L29-L63) evaluates observed and permuted ratio correlations on strictly identical denominators (`n_proteins_cat` and `n_prot_aai`) in [v3_coupling_and_comparator_audit.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v3/results/v3_coupling_and_comparator_audit.tsv).
  - **C5 (Resolved):** Comparators are accurately described as external GTDB r232 ($229$) and MGnify ($8$) reference genomes (predominantly uncultured environmental MAGs) with exact empirical AAI ranges per stratum in [v3_comparator_metadata_summary.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v3/results/v3_comparator_metadata_summary.tsv).
- **New Critical Issues:** None.

**Verdict:** `VIABLE`.
